correctness.rationale: The source equation gives the exact residual quartic in all base charts. A base-locus argument establishes the morphism. The derivative in the fourth homogeneous coordinate confines singularities to zeroes of the biquadratic discriminant unless c=0; both cases are classified exactly, including infinity. For cube roots of unity the binary form is a square, and its factorization yields two smooth conics with two local A3 contacts. Four-line fibers are reduced stars. Symbolic discriminant and square identities were verified by the included standalone code. Independent topological and Chern-class Euler computations both give 55.
